title.zh: 开放接合映射的保真与唯一共同因子
title.en: Question fidelity and unique factors of open joining maps

claim.zh: 保留接合并提升固定单位置接合的映射保留全部关联问题；两个这样的共同细化投影有唯一通向同测片段对的函数，同时保留接合并与两个投影相容。
claim.en: A join-preserving map lifting joins at one fixed participant preserves all incidence questions; two such common-refinement projections have a unique join-preserving function to the equally answering pairs commuting with both projections.

hypotheses.zh: 同一 L 的两映射 p:L→J、q:L→K 分别满足明示 OpenMap。
hypotheses.en: Two maps p:L→J and q:L→K from the same L satisfy the explicit OpenMap condition.

correspondence.zh: OpenMap 的强提升条件是给定解释条件；共同细化的投影在前一成果中另有导出。
correspondence.en: The strong OpenMap lifting condition is supplied for a given interpretation; the preceding result derives it for the canonical projections.

detail.zh: 共享 Span 定义，但唯一因子不依赖局部有限或连通覆盖定理，故不是该定理的重命名。
detail.en: Uses the same Span definition, but the factor theorem requires neither local finiteness nor the connected-coverage theorem; it is not its renamed copy.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 因子只保证保留接合和投影相容，不保证 OpenMap 或满射；无有限性要求，也没有全世界同构或唯一实际来源结论。
detail.en: The factor preserves joins and commutes with projections; it is not asserted open or onto. No finiteness is required, and no whole-world isomorphism or unique provenance follows.

limitations.zh: 因子只保证保留接合和投影相容，不保证 OpenMap 或满射；无有限性要求，也没有全世界同构或唯一实际来源结论。
limitations.en: The factor preserves joins and commutes with projections; it is not asserted open or onto. No finiteness is required, and no whole-world isomorphism or unique provenance follows.
